meta.title: dsh-nvidia-nim
meta.description: Adds NVIDIA NIM as a model provider. Models come from your own configuration and from the endpoint's own catalog; every request draws a key from a pool under per-key limits (one per second, forty per minute), and a failed request sleeps two seconds before it is sent again. Settings → Plugins → dsh-nvidia-nim adds keys in a batch, marks each one's state (pause / pin / rename / test / remove), and chooses which model ids the conversation model picker offers.
